title: 2021 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Patients With Valvular Heart Disease

definitions.Severe AS: AVA ≤1.0 cm², mean gradient ≥40 mmHg, peak velocity ≥4.0 m/s
definitions.Low-flow Low-gradient AS: AVA ≤1.0 cm², mean gradient <40 mmHg, LVEF <50% (classic) or LVEF ≥50% (paradoxical)
definitions.Severe MR: Vena contracta ≥7 mm, ERO ≥0.40 cm², regurgitant vol ≥60 mL
definitions.Primary MR: Intrinsic leaflet pathology (e.g., mitral valve prolapse, rheumatic)
definitions.Secondary MR: Functional MR due to LV dysfunction or remodelling

recommendations.text: AVR (SAVR or TAVR) is recommended for symptomatic severe AS.
TAVR is recommended for symptomatic severe AS in patients at prohibitive or high surgical risk.
For patients with severe AS at intermediate surgical risk, TAVR and SAVR are both recommended (choice based on individual anatomy and patient preference).
SAVR is recommended in asymptomatic very severe AS (Vmax ≥5.0 m/s) or when LVEF <50%.
MV repair is recommended over MV replacement for primary severe MR in patients with symptoms or LVEF ≤60% or LVESD ≥40 mm.
Transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER/MitraClip) is reasonable for selected symptomatic primary MR at prohibitive or high surgical risk.
TEER is recommended for selected severe secondary MR remaining symptomatic on GDMT (per COAPT criteria).
Commissurotomy (PBMV) is recommended for severe rheumatic mitral stenosis with MVA ≤1.5 cm² if anatomy is favorable.
Tricuspid valve intervention is reasonable for severe TR in patients undergoing left-sided valve surgery.
Anticoagulation with warfarin (INR 2.5–3.5 for mechanical mitral, 2.0–3.0 for mechanical aortic) is recommended for patients with mechanical prosthetic valves.
DOACs are not recommended in patients with mechanical heart valves.
Infective endocarditis prophylaxis is recommended for high-risk patients (prosthetic valve, prior IE, congenital HD) undergoing dental procedures involving manipulation of gingival tissue.

pharmacotherapy.indication: Add to warfarin in mechanical valve patients

pharmacotherapy.examples: amoxicillin 2 g PO 30–60 min before procedure (or clindamycin if penicillin-allergic)

key_trials.name: PARTNER 3
key_trials.finding: TAVR non-inferior to SAVR in low-risk AS at 2 years

key_trials.name: COAPT
key_trials.finding: TEER reduced HF hospitalization 47% and death 29% vs GDMT alone

key_trials.name: MITRA-FR
key_trials.finding: No significant benefit over GDMT alone (different patient selection)

key_trials.name: SURTAVI
key_trials.finding: TAVR non-inferior to SAVR in intermediate-risk severe AS
